landing.subtitle: Tap any word as it reads and the voice goes there. Step back, jump ahead, speed up or slow down, and it moves the moment you do. Each word lights up as it is spoken, in a PDF (scanned ones too), a Word file, or something you wrote.
landing.freeNote: In your browser. Nothing to install. No account.
landing.sweep: You tap a word, and it picks up there. You step back, it steps back. You pause, it waits. You slow down, it slows with you.
landing.pageTitle: The real page, not a copy of it
landing.pageSub: It reads on the page as it was made, so the word you tap is the word it speaks. The light crosses the print, the scan or your own writing, and the layout stays put.
landing.formats: PDF, Word, EPUB, Markdown, plain text. Scanned pages too, read on your device.
landing.resume: Every file opens where you left off.
landing.mockLine1: Press play at the bottom, and this page is read to you.
landing.mockLine2: The word being [spoken] lights up, so your eyes and your ears stay together.
landing.mockLine3: Click any word and a small bar appears on it.
landing.voicesSub: Three ways to hear it, all from your browser.
landing.voice1Tile: one that is [already] on your device
landing.voice1Line: Free, already installed, ready the moment you press play.
landing.voice2Line: Runs on this device, works offline, sounds closer to a person.
landing.voice3Tile: one from a [provider] you already pay
landing.voice3Line: Your provider's voices, with a key only you hold. The text it reads is sent to them.
landing.closeTitle: From the word you pick, at the pace you set.
landing.scenesTitle: A page that answers your touch
landing.scenesSub: Tap a word, change the pace, step back. The voice and the light go wherever you go.

anywhere.title: Start anywhere
anywhere.line: Tap any word and the voice picks up right there. Step back a word, a line or a paragraph, and it follows.
anywhere.text: The voice reads along at an easy pace. Somewhere in the middle a line catches your eye, so you tap the word where it begins and the reading carries on from exactly there, as if it had been waiting for you.
anywhere.c4: Step back with the arrow key.

keys.title: Hands on the keys
keys.line: Space to play or pause, arrows to step a word, Ctrl with an arrow for a paragraph, up and down for the pace. The mouse can rest.
keys.text: Your hands never leave the keys. Space starts the voice, the arrows move it one word at a time, and the pace goes up or down whenever you like, all without reaching for the mouse.

pace.title: Set the pace
pace.line: Speed up through the easy parts, slow down where it matters. The light keeps step at every speed.
pace.text: Some lines you know at a glance and some you want to hear twice. Push the pace through the easy parts, pull it back for the hard ones, and the light stays with the voice either way.

layout.title: The layout, respected
layout.line: Headings, columns and captions are read in the order your eyes would take them, on the page as it was made.
layout.heading: Reading in order
layout.col1: The heading comes first, then this column from top to bottom.
layout.col2: Only then the next column, the way your eyes would move.

scan.title: Scans that speak
scan.line: A scanned PDF becomes words on your own device, then lights up like any other.
scan.text: This page was a photograph a moment ago. Now every word on it can be heard and followed.
scan.c3: Then it reads like any other.

write.title: Hear your own words
write.line: Type or paste on a clean sheet, press play, and hear it the way someone else will.
write.text: A first draft, typed a minute ago. Hearing it aloud shows where it stumbles.
write.c3: Hear it as someone else will.

turn.label: Your turn
turn.title: Press space. It reads.
turn.sub: Or tap any word. The arrows step a word at a time, Ctrl with an arrow jumps a paragraph, up and down set the pace. Every page you open answers you like this.
turn.p1: This paragraph is waiting for you. Press space and it starts reading, with each word lit the moment it is spoken.
turn.p2: Tap any word to jump there. Step back with the left arrow, forward with the right, and change the pace with up and down.
turn.noVoice: This browser has no voice for this language yet. The words still light up.
turn.keyTap: tap a word to start there
turn.answersTitle: Everything on the page answers you

tap.title: Tap a word
tap.line: Reading picks up wherever you point.

keys.title: Keys for everything
keys.line: Play, step, jump a paragraph and set the pace without the mouse.

follow.title: The page keeps up
follow.line: It scrolls only when the voice nears the edge, so the page stays still while you read.

back.title: Continue reading
back.line: Wander anywhere on the page; one press brings you back to the voice.

pace.title: Your pace
pace.line: From three quarters to double speed, or the exact words per minute.

voices.title: A voice for every word
voices.line: A word from another language is read by a voice for that language.

report.title: Say when it's wrong
report.line: Flag a word that sounds off; a person fixes it for everyone.

resume.title: Where you left off
resume.line: Every file reopens at your last word.

turn.ctaTitle: Every page you open can do this.

key.title: Your key
key.p1: It is stored only in this browser, encrypted with a key that never leaves this device.
key.p2: Unless you tick "remember", it is kept only for this browsing session. If your browser reopens your tabs after closing, it may bring the key back too, so on a shared computer use Forget key.
key.p3: It travels only to the provider, over an encrypted connection, straight from your browser.
key.p4: This app has no server that ever receives it, and nothing is logged.
key.p5: You can revoke it at the provider at any time; "Forget key" removes it here.
key.noCrypto: This browser cannot store a key safely, so keys are disabled here.
key.stateDevice: A key is stored on this device, encrypted.
key.stateSession: A key is kept for this session only.
key.needVoicesRead: The key is refused for listing voices. In ElevenLabs, edit this key and set Voices to Read (it is lower in the permissions list than Text to Speech), then Save and test again.

key.remember: Remember on this device (encrypted). Leave off on a shared computer.
